text: In February 2026, Grab's board of directors authorized a new share repurchase program allowing the company to repurchase up to **$500 million** worth of its outstanding Class A Ordinary Shares [Grab, FY2025, p.135]. This mirrors the size of the prior program authorized in February 2024, which had been substantially completed by December 31, 2025 [Grab, FY2025, p.99]. The new program has no fixed end date, does not obligate Grab to repurchase any specific amount, and may be suspended or terminated at any time [Grab, FY2025, p.49-50].
